title: What's New in Shopify Connector: Point of Sale (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: POS integration with Business Central and employee tracking
Demo: Creating and viewing a POS transaction
Demo: Importing orders and configuring cash rounding
Demo: Salesperson mapping from POS to Business Central

features.name: Shopify POS integration with Business Central
features.description: Shopify POS transactions are integrated into Shopify admin as normal sales orders and can be imported into Business Central as sales documents or invoices.
caveats: POS orders have specific nuances related to rounding and employee tracking
Orders must be properly configured for import

features.name: Cash rounding for POS transactions
features.description: Automatic cash rounding applied to POS transactions in countries like Denmark and Canada where the smallest coin value requires rounding. Shopify POS handles this automatically and tracks the rounding difference.
caveats: Only applies in countries with cash rounding requirements
Rounding account must be configured in Business Central

features.name: Staff members mapping for employee tracking
features.description: New mapping table that maps Shopify POS staff members to Business Central salesperson codes. When a POS order is imported, the system automatically assigns the correct salesperson based on who performed the transaction in Shopify.
caveats: Requires staff members to be registered in Shopify

features.name: Payment routing amount field
features.description: New field on imported POS orders that tracks the payment method and routing information from Shopify POS transactions.

features.name: Cash rounding account configuration
features.description: New field on the order synchronization and processing tab in Shopify shop setup to specify which G/L account should receive the cash rounding difference when POS transactions are imported.
caveats: Must be configured before creating sales documents from POS orders

features.name: Catalog and market-based pricing for POS
features.description: New market feature allowing creation of catalogs associated with specific markets representing POS locations in specific countries or combinations, enabling impact on how pricing is defined.
caveats: Details to be covered in a separate video
